mapcheck.entry.none: The map has no entry points; OMSI needs one to start a bus on it.
mapcheck.entry.summary: {ok} of {count} entry points lie on their object.

mapcheck.varparents.none: No element takes its variables from another.
mapcheck.files.missing: {path} is not in the OMSI installation
mapcheck.files.summary: {ok} of {count} object and spline files are installed.
mapcheck.junctions.finding: {state, select, invalid {invalid: } review {review: } other {free: }}#{id} {name} in tile {x}, {y}: {message}
@mapcheck.junctions.finding: {message} is a message of MapWorks in English
mapcheck.junctions.none: No object of the map has connection points.
mapcheck.junctions.summary: {connected} of {count} connection points of {objects} junction objects are connected; {review} to review, {invalid} invalid, {free} free.
mapcheck.timetable.summary: {stops} stops, {links} station links, {tracks} tracks, {trips} trips, {lines} lines with {tours} tours and {scheduled} scheduled trips; {findings, plural, =0 {all references hold.} one {# finding.} other {# findings.}}
mapcheck.chrono.none: The map has no chrono variants.

mapcheck.chrono.summary: {count, plural, one {# variant} other {# variants}}; all together they add {objects} objects and {splines} splines, delete {deleted} element(s) and change the type of {changed}.
mapcheck.report.title: Map check of {name}
mapcheck.made.none: No objects were made for this project under {folder}.
mapcheck.made.all_used: All {count, plural, one {# object} other {# objects}} made for this project under {folder} are named by a map of the installation, an export or the undo history.
mapcheck.made.unused: {unused} of {count, plural, one {# object} other {# objects}} made for this project under {folder} ({size}) are named by no map of the installation, no export and not by the undo history, such as junctions made again. Delete unused removes their folders; maps of other projects with the same name are not looked at.
mapcheck.made.deleted: Deleted {count, plural, one {# unused folder} other {# unused folders}} under {folder}.{problems, plural, =0 {} one { # could not be deleted.} other { # could not be deleted.}}
mapcheck.chain.ok: Every spline stores how far along its chain it begins.
mapcheck.chain.stale: {count, plural, one {# spline stores a chain offset that is not where its chain puts it} other {# splines store a chain offset that is not where their chain puts them}}, such as roads built with earlier versions of this editor, which wrote 0. openOMSI counts the rows along a spline from that value and runs its textures on from it. Store offsets writes the right values and moves the rows along those splines with them, so they stay where they stand.
mapcheck.chain.finding: Spline #{id} in tile {x}, {y}: stores {stored, number, 0.##} m, its chain begins {start, number, 0.##} m before it
mapcheck.chain.stored: Stored the chain offsets of {count, plural, one {# spline} other {# splines}} and moved the rows along them with them.{differ, plural, =0 {} one { # still differs.} other { # still differ.}}
mapcheck.dlc.reading: The origin of the objects is still being read; run the check again in a moment.
mapcheck.dlc.unknown: DLC objects cannot be told apart without Steam's file lists or folders marked as DLC.
mapcheck.dlc.none: No DLC objects: the map needs only the base game and freeware.
mapcheck.dlc.some: {kinds, plural, one {# DLC object} other {# DLC objects}} in {placements, plural, one {# placement} other {# placements}}, such as {example}; players without that DLC miss them.
mapcheck.parking.none: The map has no parking spaces.
mapcheck.parking.summary: {count, plural, one {# parking space} other {# parking spaces}}, {usable} where cars can park in{problems, plural, =0 {} one {; # problem with a parking list} other {; # problems with parking lists}}.

mapcheck.parking.side: parking space {id} in tile {x}, {y} lies {value, number, 0.0} m to the right of its lane; cars park in from 1.2 to 4.2 m
mapcheck.parking.heading: parking space {id} in tile {x}, {y} is turned {value, number, 0}° against its lane (at most 12°)
mapcheck.parking.laneend: parking space {id} in tile {x}, {y} is too near the end of its lane ({value, number, 0.0} m; 8 m before and 4 m after are needed)
mapcheck.parking.no_list: The map has no {file}, so its car parks (for example space {id}) stay empty in openOMSI.
mapcheck.parking.list_missing: A car park (space {id}) names a parking list that does not exist: {file}.
mapcheck.parking.car: {file} names {car}, which is not in the OMSI installation.
